answer_1.quote: The task of graph-to-text generation aims to automatically produce natural language descriptions of knowledge graphs.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions of knowledge graphs

answer_2.quote: automatic evaluation results using standard natural language generation metrics BLEU, METEOR and chrF++.

answer_4.quote: Three human annotators evaluated the quality of the graph-sentence pairs in GraphNarrative.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluators scored based on numbers of hallucinated entities, missed entities, hallucinated relations, missed relations, and average grammar errors per sentence.
